Overview Updated October 2026

One by MSN is a 4 BHK residential project by MSN Realty in Neopolis, Kokapet, Hyderabad, with homes of 5,250–7,460 sq.ft. The project spans 7.7 acres, 5 towers, 655 residences. Indicative prices start at ₹10 Cr (July 2026).
